subject: Freezzard
text: A Freezzard can be defeated in one hit by using a Jump Attack with the Biggoron Sword or the Megaton Hammer.

evidence.quote: Kill the Freezzard at the other end (he tends to hog up this part of the path, so use a Jump Attack with the Biggoron Sword or a Megaton Hammer for a 1HKO).

subject: Dungeon Map
text: The Dungeon Map is inside a large chest that must be melted with Blue Fire.

evidence.quote: Use the Blue Fire on the large chest to the right of the (dead) Freezzard, and open it to get the Dungeon Map (the pot frozen with Red Ice contains a fairy).

subject: Compass
text: Melting the Red Ice covering the chest on the right side of the room with Blue Fire yields the Compass.

evidence.quote: Refill your empty bottle with Blue Flame, then use both of your bottles of Blue Flame to melt the Red Ice covering the chest on the right side of the room, and the Piece of Heart on the left side of the room. Open the chest to get the Compass.

subject: Piece of Heart
text: A Piece of Heart is encased in Red Ice on the left side of the room and requires Blue Flame to melt.

evidence.quote: Refill your empty bottle with Blue Flame, then use both of your bottles of Blue Flame to melt the Red Ice covering the chest on the right side of the room, and the Piece of Heart on the left side of the room.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: A Gold Skulltula hangs on the wall to the right of the Piece of Heart.

evidence.quote: When you get the Piece of Heart, look on the wall to the right to see a Gold Skulltula. Kill it and take it's token.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: A Gold Skulltula is located in the corner to the right upon entering the block pushing room and can be retrieved using the Hookshot.

evidence.quote: While you're getting rid of the Keese, get the Gold Skulltula in the corner (to your right as you come in from the GFSTIPD room) and take it's token with the Hookshot.

subject: Ice Block Puzzle
text: Push the ice block east, climb it to reach the silver rupee on the stone block, push the ice block east again to reach the alcove, melt the Red Ice with Blue Fire for another rupee, respawn the block off a cliff, push it south to reach the third rupee, push it west for the fourth rupee, and push it north onto the stone to get the final rupee and open the door.

evidence.quote: Go back to the ice block in the room, and grab it from it's east side and push forward. Now, climb on top of it, and use it to reach the silver rupee on top of the tall stone block. Go to the west side of the block, and push it east. Get on top of it, and climb into the small alcove. Use your remaining bottle of Blue Fire to melt the Red Ice and take the Silver Rupee inside. Drop back down out of the alcove and push the ice block to the north or south and off the cliff to make it respawn at the entrance to the room....Now, grab the ice block from it's north side and push it south. Jump onto the ice block and use it to reach the silver rupee on top of the rock. Now, grab onto the east side of the stone block and push it to the west. Climb on top of the ice block, and grab the silver rupee on top of the stone. Next, jump back down, and get on the south side of the ice block. Push it north. Grab the silver rupee from the stone that the ice block has to come rest on, and the door will open.

subject: Block of Time
text: Playing the Song of Time makes a Block of Time appear to help reach a bundle of Red Rupees hanging high above the ground.

evidence.quote: If you want that bundle of Red Rupees hanging high above the ground, then play the Song of Time here to make a Block of Time appear, which you can then use.

subject: White Wolfos
text: The White Wolfos can be killed in one hit with the Master Sword by backflipping away from its strike and landing an immediate Jump Attack.

evidence.quote: Allow the Wolfos to strike at you, then backflip out of it's way at the last minute, then use a Jump Attack as soon as you land. Even with the Master Sword, it dies in one shot.

subject: Iron Boots
text: Defeating the White Wolfos spawns a chest containing the Iron Boots, which allow Link to walk underwater.

evidence.quote: Once the White Wolfos is gone, then a chest will appear. Open it to get the Iron Boots, which let you walk underwater.

subject: Serenade of Water
text: Sheik appears after obtaining the Iron Boots to teach the Serenade of Water, which warps to the Water Temple in Lake Hylia.

evidence.quote: At this point, Sheik will appear and teach your the Serenade of Water, which will take you right to the Water Temple in Lake Hylia.

subject: Piece of Heart
text: A Piece of Heart is found at the bottom of the pool outside the Ice Cavern entrance by sinking with the Iron Boots.

evidence.quote: As soon as you come out of the Ice Cavern, don your Iron Boots and drop down into the pool of water. Float to the bottom where you will find a Piece of Heart.

subject: Zora Tunic
text: King Zora rewards Link with the Zora Tunic, which enables breathing underwater, after being unfrozen with Blue Fire.

evidence.quote: Use your last remaining bottle of Blue Fire on King Zora to unfreeze him. Out of gratitude, he will give you the Zora Tunic, which lets you breath underwater.

subject: Zora's Shop
text: Using Blue Fire to unfreeze the entrance to Zora's Shop grants access to extra Zora Tunics and other items.

evidence.quote: If you have an extra bottle of Blue Fire, then you can use it to unfreeze the entrance to the Zora's Shop, which sells extra Zora Tunics, in addition to other useless trinkets.

subject: Biggoron's Sword
text: Transportation songs such as Serenade of Water and Bolero of Fire must not be used while delivering timed items like the Eyeball Frog and Eyedrops.

evidence.quote: Remember not to use any transportation songs. This means that you can't use the Serenade of Water when you're delivering the Eyeball Frog, or the Bolero of Fire when you're delivering the Eyedrops.

subject: Piece of Heart
text: Bombing the south side of a lone golden tree northwest of Lon Lon Ranch opens a grotto where a Piece of Heart lies submerged underwater.

evidence.quote: Drop a bomb on the tree's south side to open a pit. Drop down the pit, and you'll find a deep pool of water with a Piece of Heart at it's bottom. Use the Iron Boots to sink down and reach the Piece of Heart.

subject: Piece of Heart
text: A Piece of Heart sits atop the high tower of the Lakeside Laboratory roof.

evidence.quote: Once on the roof of the Observatory, you can begin climbing the ladder to the top of the high tower. Your old friends from Lon Lon Ranch, the Guay's, return here to harass you on your way up. They may accost you on the way up, they may not. It depends on chance, really. On top of the tower is a Piece of Heart.

subject: Fishing Pond
text: Playing the Scarecrow's Song on the northern edge of the Fishing Pond island summons Pierre, allowing Link to Hookshot over and enter the Fishing Pond early.

evidence.quote: Normally the Fishing Pond is inaccessible until you've restored Lake Hylia, but with the help of the Scarecrow's Song you can cheat a little bit. Go to the northern edge of the Fishing Pond's island, and Navi will flutter up and turn green. Play the Scarecrow's Song, and Pierre will appear. Pull yourself up to him with the Hookshot and enter the Fishing Pond.
